style_int.description: Text style for integer (or float) types. Possible styles documented in Term::ANSIColor.

style_null.description: Text style for the NULL value. Possible styles documented in Term::ANSIColor.

style_nudatell.description: Text style for datetimes (and date) values. Possible styles documented in Term::ANSIColor.

style_header.description: Text style for row headers. Possible styles documented in Term::ANSIColor.

style_row.description: Text style for row header when mysql is used with the '\G' flag. Possible styles documented in Term::ANSIColor.

long_lines_to_less.description: Defaults to 1. When 1, switches to less on long lines. When 0, only checks height.

less_options_overrides_env.description: Defaults to 0. Set to 1 to override the $LESS environment variable options.

use_less.description: Determine when mypager will use the less executable. Valid options: 'auto', 'always', 'never'.

fix_utf8.description: Use to 'fix' broken MySQL client UTF-8 output. Defaults to 0 (disabled).
